statement_of_scope: Every figure below is an illustrative planning assumption for a synthetic bank. Bantam holds no real customers, deposits, or funds, and these values are not audited accounts, regulatory returns, or a claim about any real firm. Replace them with finance-owned figures before any decision use.

regulatory.regime: UK FCA/PRA operational resilience and UK GDPR

notes: Impact tolerance is the board's stated maximum tolerable annual loss for the important business services in scope.
Maximum credible single loss caps any one simulated event; it is anchored to liquid reserves plus insurable cover, not to total assets.
Cyber cover and retention are used to convert gross simulated loss into net retained loss.
